comment: Generated by cmd/compatgen — do not hand-edit; `make generate-compat-model` rewrites this file wholly from compat/model/scenarios/. Every loader concatenates it with registry.json, which stays the reviewable hand-written half. A group appears here only while at least one suite has a scenario backend (the scenarioBackends table in cmd/compatgen/registry.go), because `suites` is derived from backend availability and must not be empty; until then the file stays empty and must leave every gate, report and dashboard behaving exactly as before it existed. See docs/plans/compat-coverage-modelgen.md § 3.6.
